description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers DE+EN phrasings for position-aware clause-by-clause review of a contract (EU/DE). Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbours: NDA triage (nda-triage), DPA review (dpa-review), 'is this a legal problem' triage (legal-intake-triage), and non-legal contract-of-work.
